key_expressions: Do you have something less spicy?,
Can I get this to go?,

A: Hi, do you have a recommended dish?
Oh, that sounds good! Is it very spicy?
Great, I’ll take that.
B: Yes, this pasta is the most popular today!
No, it’s not too spicy.
Okay, I’ll prepare one for you!

A: What does this soup taste like?
Oh, a clean flavor sounds nice! Is the portion big?
Then I’ll have one soup, please.
B: It’s mild and warm.
Yes, one bowl is filling enough.
Alright, I’ll get it ready!

A: Do you have something less spicy?
Oh, so that dish is barely spicy?
Nice, I’ll order one.
B: Yes, this one is almost not spicy at all.
Even kids enjoy it.
Sure, I’ll make one for you!

A: Can I get this to go?
Oh, great! Does it take long to pack?
Okay, please pack it for me.
B: Yes, we can pack it.
No, it only takes a moment.
I’ll prepare it right away!

A: What drinks are popular here?
Oh, I like refreshing things! Can you put less ice?
Great, I’ll take that one.
B: Lemon tea is very popular these days.
Sure, I’ll put less ice for you.
Alright, I’ll make one!

A: Will the food be ready soon?
Oh, good! I’m glad it won’t take long.
Okay, I’ll wait a little.
B: Yes, it’s almost done.
It’ll be out in about five minutes.
I’ll bring it to you soon!

A: What side dishes do you have?
Oh, that sounds light! How big is the portion?
Then I’ll have the fries.
B: We have salad and fries.
It’s a good portion for one person.
Alright, I’ll prepare that!

A: Is this a large portion?
Oh, two people can share it?
Great! I’ll share it with my friend.
B: Yes, it’s pretty big.
Yes, it's enough for two people.
Enjoy your meal!

A: How do I pay here?
Oh, nice! There are a lot of options.
Okay, I’ll pay by card.
B: We take card and cash.
Yes, we also accept mobile payments.
Sure, please hand me your card!

A: Do you offer refills?
Oh, free refills? That’s nice!
Then I’d like a refill with hot water, please.
B: Yes, some drinks come with free refills.
Yes, feel free to ask anytime.
I’ll bring you hot water!
